description: Approved baseline monetary-float findings. New findings fail CI.

allowlist.justification: Intentional finite Decimal-to-cvxpy conversion isolated at the typed solver boundary; domain outputs re-enter as Decimal at 0.0001 precision. Recheck if the solver accepts Decimal inputs without coercion; original isolation evidence is in #544.
Non-financial parsing for bounded timeout, retry-backoff and cache-duration configuration consumed by float-based runtime libraries; no amount, price, rate, weight or return enters this boundary.
Non-financial monotonic-clock expiry timestamp matching time.monotonic() and configured duration semantics; it is never persisted, serialized or used in portfolio calculations.
